sonnet.problem: The card says "there's no go-between this time." Verse 8 only says "Then the LORD said to Aaron." It doesn't say whether Moses was or wasn't the channel. The card adds a claim about how God spoke, and it implies that earlier speech in the passage had a go-between.
sonnet.rule: Don't stretch the text. Exaggerate only in his own jokes.

sonnet.problem: Verses 12-15 are a run of offering-portion rules. The summary card goes item by item: the grain offering eaten without leaven beside the altar, the breast, the thigh, sons and daughters, a clean place, and permanence. It should say in a few words what the stretch covers and name at most a standout detail.
sonnet.rule: He says in a few words what it covers and doesn't go item by item.
